lede: Denver Broncos carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#15 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Carolina Panthers +2.5 with a fair total of 43.5 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Carolina Panthers pass offence vs Denver Broncos pass defence, which sits −0.206 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Denver Broncos and Carolina Panthers have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
